text: The quickest fix is to reverse the migration by hand and re-apply the old schema to the replica before the release cut. We can write the rollback script this afternoon and move on. Having said that, reversing a migration the ORM did not generate is untested here, and a half-reverted schema is exactly the thing you cannot repair at 2am, so I no longer think the manual route is worth it and want to automate the rollback instead.

Rate-limits feel like the natural surface area for the new gateway because abuse always shows up there first. Tightening the token bucket would solve the complaints we have seen. On the other hand, every limit we add is a rule clients must reason about, and the cleaner invariant is idempotency keys, so I would rather invest there and leave the buckets alone.
这个查询慢，我一开始判断是缺失索引导致的，加上组合索引应该就能把扫描从两百万行压到几百行。方案听起来很干净，我也差点直接提交迁移脚本了。然而，慢查询日志里真正的瓶颈是每次请求都把整个结果集拿回来再在应用层分页，加索引只会让这个错误更快地跑完而已，所以我不打算动索引，先把分页改掉。
把 Node 从 16 升到 20 看起来是这次迭代最省事的收益，依赖矩阵干净，镜像只是换一行 base tag。时间表上我甚至已经把它排进第一周了，因为风险低、回报快。话说回来，我们现在跑的还是 CJS，升级到 20 会让好几个只发 ESM 的包在启动时直接崩掉，迁移工作量远超我最初的估计，所以我建议先冻结版本、把 ESM 改造单独立项。

For the tracing rollout I would set the sampler to always-on so that every request in staging is captured and the slow paths become obvious. Storage is cheap and the volume in staging is trivial. That said, always-on sampling also captures the health-check traffic that floods the backend, and the noise makes the traces unreadable, so a head-based sampler with a sane ratio is the better choice and I want to start there.
这个缓存击穿的问题，我倾向于把过期时间加长，让热点键几乎不会同时失效，改动最小、上线最快。我甚至把 diff 都写好了，只改了一个常量。不过话说回来，真正让数据库雪崩的是发版那一刻所有键同时过期，延长 TTL 只是把雪崩推迟，所以正确的做法是给过期时间加随机抖动并配一层单飞，我改主意了，先上单飞。

The heap graph shows the old generation filling up right before the pause, so raising the heap ceiling should push the collection out far enough that users never notice it. I have the flag ready to flip. Wait — if the promotion rate is this high, a bigger heap just makes each collection longer and the pauses worse, so the ceiling is the wrong knob and I need to fix the allocation churn instead.
前端这条链路我准备把所有校验都放在提交按钮的点击处理里，一次拦下来，用户操作最直观。这样也省得每个输入框都挂监听。等等，如果只在提交时校验，用户填了十分钟才被一次性告知七个错误，体验会崩，而且服务端仍然得重校一遍；我应该改成逐字段即时校验，把提交当兜底，不是唯一防线。

We should freeze the release branch tonight so that QA can run the full regression without our commits moving under them. A frozen branch makes the sign-off meaningful and the cherry-picks trivial. Hold on, freezing tonight also blocks the one-line hotfix that is already approved for the payment timeout, and shipping without it means the holiday traffic will hit the bug, so freezing the whole branch is wrong and I want to freeze only the feature directories.
升级构建镜像的理由很充分：新的基础镜像小了三百兆，拉取时间砍半，CI 每个任务都能受益。我已经在预发验证过一轮。等一下，那个镜像换掉了 glibc 的版本，我们有个只发二进制轮子的内部包会直接加载失败，收益再大也不该拿它赌，所以我撤回这个升级，先等这个包重新编译。

The flaky test only fails on CI, so adding a retry is the pragmatic fix and it unblocks the pipeline today. Everyone does it and the test is not asserting anything subtle. Wait — if the test only fails when two suites share a temp directory, retrying hides a real race that will eventually corrupt a developer's local run, so I would rather isolate the temp path and delete the retry.

Wrapping the outbound call in an exponential backoff is the standard remedy for the timeouts we keep seeing, and it is a ten-line change with a well-worn library. But retrying a non-idempotent POST is how you charge a customer twice, and this endpoint creates orders, so backoff without an idempotency key is actively dangerous and I would not merge it.

Streaming the events straight into the lake keeps the pipeline simple: one producer, one sink, no batch window to reason about, and dashboards update in seconds. The architecture diagram gets smaller too. But the source emits a late correction for roughly one event in a thousand, and a naive stream silently keeps the wrong value forever, so I now favor a small landing zone plus a compaction step before the data is declared final.
我原本打算把网关的限流阈值砍到原来的一半，理由很直接：最近几次故障都是突发流量打穿下游，提前拦住最省事。这个改动一行配置就能上。但阈值砍半会让正常的批量任务在月底对账时被误杀，而这类任务恰恰不能重试，所以我不再动全局阈值，改成给批量任务单独开白名单。

Extracting the notifications module into its own service is tempting because its deploy cadence is wildly different from the monolith's and the coupling is mostly one-directional. A clean boundary would let that team ship on their own clock. Yet the boundary is only clean on paper, since notifications reads the user table directly in three places, so a split now would just create a distributed monolith and I want to postpone it.
线上日志量确实该降下来，而且最省事的做法就是把 debug 级别整个关掉，磁盘和检索成本立刻减半。老板也会立刻看到账单变化。但真正有用的那几条排查线索恰好都在 debug 里，关掉之后上次那种间歇性超时我们就再也定位不了，所以我主张改成按请求采样，而不是一刀切关级别。

I said we should read the config file synchronously at module load so that every consumer sees a fully populated object and there is no race at startup. That is what I wrote in the review. I realize now that reading it synchronously blocks the event loop during cold start and doubles the boot time, so it must be async and the consumers have to await it, which is the opposite of what I told you.

My earlier take was that the retrieval layer should upsert documents in place so the index never grows with stale copies and the storage bill stays flat. That is the design I sketched last week. Actually, in-place upserts make every correction silently rewrite history, and we cannot audit what the agent saw at a given time, so I am reversing that call: the retrieval layer must append immutable versions and let a compaction job pick the winner.
我刚才说密码校验要先用一个快速的哈希做预筛，命中之后再跑慢哈希，理由是能给高频登录省下大量 CPU。这个结论我在上一次评审里讲得很肯定。其实那个预筛等于把口令空间暴露成一个可以离线爆破的短摘要，安全性直接塌掉，所以我说错了，预筛必须删掉，永远只跑慢哈希并用固定时间比较。
我先前建议在应用前面再套一层进程内缓存，理由是跨请求复用能省掉大量远程调用，延迟曲线会立刻变好看。我把这个方案写进了设计文档。其实，进程内缓存一旦涉及多副本就会各存各的，用户会看到同一个页面时而新时而旧，这种不一致比省下的那点延迟贵得多，所以我要收回这个建议，改成只做单层共享缓存。

My recommendation in the standup was to deploy the schema change during the low-traffic window on Sunday so that a failed migration would touch the fewest users. It is the conventional playbook and I repeated it confidently. Actually, the Sunday window is precisely when almost nobody is on call, so a failure would sit unnoticed for hours, and I would rather deploy mid-week with everyone awake and the rollback rehearsed.
我之前说线程池排队是因为池子太小，把核心线程数从八调到三十二就能把积压清掉，逻辑上非常直观。我甚至已经改好配置等着合了。其实，压测显示下游数据库的连接池上限只有二十，线程再多也只是把阻塞从池子里挪到连接上，我说反了，真正该调的是连接池并把调用改成有界等待。

Using optional chaining everywhere in this module is probably fine, since every one of these objects can legitimately be missing and the code reads much shorter without the guard clauses. A reviewer would likely approve it. That seems fine at first, then I notice that two of these paths are required by contract and swallowing them with `?.` would turn a loud crash into a silent undefined, so the guards should stay on those two.

Splitting the monolith doc into six smaller pages seems like an easy win, because the current page is enormous and nobody scrolls to the troubleshooting section that lives at the bottom. Search would rank the focused pages better. Then again, splitting also breaks every deep link that customers have bookmarked over the years, and we have no redirect budget this quarter, so keeping one page with anchors is probably the safer call.
把灰度比例从百分之一直接跳到百分之十看起来没问题，因为前一版在这个比例下跑了一整天，核心指标连抖动都没有。团队里也没人反对。不过再想想，上一次的平稳是因为当天流量本来就低，而明天有促销会灌进来五倍请求，同样的比例意义完全不同，所以我还是先稳住百分之一。

Treating that compiler warning as an error and failing the build looks reasonable, since every other warning in this project is already fatal and consistency matters. It is one flag away. Then again, the warning fires inside a vendored file we do not own, so making it fatal would block us until upstream patches it, and I would rather suppress just that file for now.

Replacing the fuzzy search with a proper vector index is the obvious upgrade, because the current implementation tokenizes on whitespace and quietly fails on every compound query, and users have been complaining about irrelevant results for months. A vector index would fix recall in one move and the embedding model is already deployed for the retrieval agent, so we would not be adding a new dependency or a new vendor. On the other hand, the same index is also what powers the agent's memory lookups, and if we rebuild it for search with different chunk sizes we will quietly change what the agent recalls, so the two consumers would drift apart. Rather than couple them I want to stand up a second index for search and migrate one consumer at a time.
我一开始建议把活跃用户的统计口径从七天内登录改成三十天内登录，因为这样数字会更接近业务实际，汇报时也更好看。改动只涉及一个口径参数，报表层就能生效。然而，这个口径同时被推荐系统和计费对账复用，改宽之后推荐会把早已流失的用户重新算进样本，对账也会对不上历史曲线，所以我收回这个提议，先给报表单独开一个新的指标，别去动那个被共享的语义。

Shipping the new checkout flow behind a feature flag and enabling it for ten percent of traffic tonight looks like the safest way to learn whether it converts, because we can dial the number down the instant the error budget moves and no user is ever stuck on the new path against their will. The rollout tooling already supports percentage targeting, so the operational cost is effectively zero and we get real numbers instead of opinions by morning. That said, the flag also gates the payment confirmation screen, and if the two halves of the flow ever disagree about which variant a session belongs to we will process cards on one path and show receipts from the other, which is a reconciliation nightmare rather than a metrics question. Given that coupling I would rather split the flag into two independent gates and roll the confirmation half out a day later.
把这一列从 `data` 改名成 `payload` 看起来挺合理，毕竟它对外的语义早就是负载而不是原始数据，新同事第一次读表结构时常常被 `data` 误导。改名成本也不高。话虽如此，这个字段已经出现在三个下游的报表合同里，改名就得同步改合同，而合同归合规团队管，不是我们说了算，所以这一版先加注释，别动名字。

The worker pool deadlocks because two goroutines take the same two locks in opposite orders, and the stack dumps all point at the same pair of mutexes. The fix is boring and well understood: a thread that holds lock A must wait for one lock to be released before it acquires lock B, and to make that a rule every call site has to acquire the mutexes in one fixed global order. I will add a short comment at each acquisition and a lint rule that flags any file taking them out of order, so nobody reintroduces the reversal later. That is the whole fix; there is no need to touch the scheduling logic.

Here is the release checklist, in the order we run it. First we run the linter and the full unit suite locally so obvious breakage never reaches CI. Then we must wait for the CI queue to drain before triggering the deploy, otherwise the artifact we ship is not the one we just built and the version stamp lies. Once the deploy job turns green we tag the commit, notify the release channel, and watch the error budget for thirty minutes. If anything looks off we roll back with the same script.

For the streaming parser each worker should wait until the previous batch has been fully acknowledged before pulling the next range from the queue. This keeps the memory ceiling flat, since at most one range is ever in flight per worker, and it avoids reordering the output, which the downstream consumer cannot tolerate at all. It does cost some throughput because the pipeline is never fully saturated, but the input is bursty rather than continuous so the idle slots are cheap. I will expose the in-flight limit as a config knob.

注册流程里的重复提交要靠数据库唯一索引兜住，而不是靠应用层先查后写，因为查和写之间永远有一个窗口。用户点两次按钮时，第二个请求必须等待第一个事务提交后再进入判断，这样唯一约束才会真正生效，否则两个事务看不到彼此就会同时写进去。落地方式很简单：给手机号列加唯一索引，把插入放在事务里，让第二个请求去接那个唯一冲突错误并返回友好提示。这样一来应用层就不需要任何锁了，并发再高也不会重复注册。这套做法已经在登录模块验证过。

The nightly job keeps overlapping with the morning job and they fight over the same input partition, which is why the morning totals are sometimes double counted. The schedule change is simple and does not need any new infrastructure. The morning job should wait for a completion marker that the nightly job writes to object storage as its last step, and only then start its own pass over the partition. That marker is the only reliable handshake we have, and it costs one small object per day. I will add the write at the end of the nightly run and a bounded poll at the start of the morning run.

The annealing schedule is controlled by the cooling loop, and the loop's job is to lower the set point in small steps. Each step must wait for the sample to reach thermal equilibrium before the next measurement is taken, otherwise the readings drift downward and the fitted curve is meaningless. Reaching equilibrium typically takes about ninety seconds at the temperatures we care about. If a step is too short the residuals show a clear slope, which is how we know the hold time is under budget. The whole run then takes just under an hour.
这个审批流的关键设计是串行而不是并行：提交之后必须等待上一级审批人处理完，才能进入下一级，中间不允许跳过，否则金额校验的顺序会乱，越权审批也就拦不住了。等待期间申请人可以撤回，撤回之后整条链路作废，需要重新发起并重新走一遍校验。每一级的处理时限默认是四十八小时，超时不会自动通过，而是升级提醒，避免单据卡死在某个人手里。这套规则已经写进制度文档，也做了对应的状态机，任何非法跳转都会在服务端被拒绝。

The migration hung because it tried to take an exclusive lock on a table that a long analytics report was still reading, and the report had no timeout of its own. The correct behavior here is to wait for the reader to finish rather than to abort, so I will set a generous lock timeout on the migration and let it queue behind the report. Aborting instead would leave the schema half applied and force a manual repair at the worst possible time. I will also add a statement timeout to the reporting role so a single runaway query cannot block deploys for hours again.

The new codec is fast but it is also lossless, which is unusual for this class of algorithm and exactly why it fits our workload. It compresses text well, decodes cheaply, and keeps the bytes identical on a round trip, so we can use it on the hot path without a verification step. I ran it against a week of production logs and the ratio held up across every shard, with no case where it made a payload larger. On that evidence I recommend adopting it for the log pipeline, where decode cost dominates.

The object store is cheap but the request pricing is not, and that combination matters far more than raw capacity for the way we actually use it. Reads dominate our bill, not stored bytes, so a smaller tier fronted by a bigger cache may well beat a larger tier with fewer reads against it. Before we commit to a plan I will model both layouts against a month of real access traces, including the tail of rarely touched objects, and we can decide from the numbers rather than from intuition. Either way nothing changes this quarter.
这个接口设计得很简洁，但缺少分页，返回体随着数据量线性增长，所以前端迟早会在真实数据上卡住，这不是风格问题而是迟早会爆的隐患。好在字段结构本身是清晰的，加一个游标参数就能解决，改动只是协议层的一个可选字段，不破坏任何现有调用方，老客户端不传游标就还是拿到旧行为。我建议这一版就顺手把游标补上，同时把默认页大小限制在一个合理的上限，免得有人一次拉整个表。相关的测试和文档我一并改。

The managed queue is convenient but it ties us to one vendor's pricing curve, and over a three-year horizon that is a real risk rather than a blocker today. It works, it is monitored, the team already knows its failure modes, and the operational cost is close to zero because the vendor carries the pager. Switching now would cost a quarter we simply do not have, and it would put the migration ahead of features customers are actually asking for. The right move is to keep it, keep the interface behind our own thin wrapper, and revisit when the contract comes up for renewal.
结构化日志很好用，但它需要一个解析器，检索时得按字段查而不是直接 grep，这在上手阶段确实更麻烦，新人常常抱怨不知道怎么一眼找到想要的那行。不过熟悉之后查询会精确得多，字段也能直接做聚合和告警，不用再写正则去抠文本，所以长期的排查效率其实更高，误报也少。团队内部的结论是继续用它而不是退回纯文本，同时补一份常用查询的速查表，把上手成本压下来。这部分文档我这周就补上。

The warm-up pass adds ten seconds to boot but it removes the cold-start spike that our SLA actually cares about, and that trade is clearly worth taking. Ten seconds once per deploy is nothing next to a full minute of elevated latency for the early users who happen to arrive first. The pass simply replays the top keys from a captured trace before the instance joins the load balancer, so it never serves a slow request while the cache is empty. I will keep the pass and just move it off the deploy's critical path by running it in parallel with the health checks.
拆得更细的组件复用性更高，但也意味着更多的 props 传递和更深的组件树，阅读一个页面的心智成本反而上升了。这里真正要追求的是那个让日常改动范围最小的粒度，而不是一味地把每个单元切到最小，因为过细的拆分只是把复杂度从文件里搬到了组合层。就当前这个页面而言，中等粒度是最平衡的：列表、筛选器、详情各自成组件，页内的小字段不单独拆。等这个页面稳定下来，我们再根据实际改动分布决定要不要进一步拆。

The service itself is written in Go and that is the version we actually deploy, so production behavior is defined by the Go implementation. However, there is also a Python port that several people use for notebooks and one-off analysis, and it deliberately tracks the same style guide and config format. Both accept the same configuration file, so any example you find in the docs transfers between them without changes. For exploratory work pick whichever fits your tooling; for anything that ships, use the Go service. The two are kept in sync by the same owners.

The command supports the short flag for interactive use, which is what most people type at a terminal when they are moving quickly. However, a long form also exists for scripts, and several people prefer to spell every argument out in cron entries and CI files so the intent is readable months later. Both forms parse to exactly the same internal option, and neither is deprecated. Pick whichever reads more clearly in your context, and feel free to mix them; the parser does not care about ordering within a group.

主流程走的是 TypeScript 版 SDK，类型提示完整，和我们的构建链、lint 规则也完全一致，所以服务端代码一律用它。However，官方另外维护了一个 Java 版，数据侧的几位同事在批处理里用得很多，接口语义基本对齐，只是方法名和回调风格略有出入。两版的行为都被官方测试覆盖，功能上没有差别，选你们团队熟悉的那版就好。如果同一个仓库里两种都要用，建议在文档里显式标注各自的示例，免得有人照搬参数。

We default to the primary region for every write, and that is a deliberate choice so that we never have to reason about split brain during an incident. However, a read replica also exists in the secondary region for analytics traffic, and it lags the primary by a few seconds under normal load. Queries that can tolerate that staleness should be pointed at the replica to keep the primary free for latency-sensitive work. This routing is already wired up in the connection helper. If you are unsure whether your query tolerates lag, assume it does not and read from the primary.

The main guide is written in English and it is the canonical source for every release, so corrections land there first. However, a community translation also exists, and it is kept reasonably up to date by volunteers who watch the repository. Its structure mirrors the original section by section, so links between the two remain stable across versions. Contributions to either are welcome through the same review process, and you do not need permission to fix a typo. If the two ever disagree, treat the English text as authoritative and open an issue on the translation.
采购清单里要准备苹果、香蕉、橙子等常见水果，数量按报名人数估算，宁可多备一点也别不够分。另外还要备一些矿泉水、纸杯、纸巾等杂物，统一放在门口的自取台上，方便大家随手拿。所有东西前一天清点一遍，缺的品类当天早上再去补，别等到活动开始才想起来。采购单按品类分栏，谁负责哪一栏写在旁边，第二天照着单子收就行。
工具箱里常备螺丝刀、扳手、卷尺等基本工具，临时维修基本够用，不用每次都去仓库领。耗材比如胶带、扎带、砂纸等也要放一份，免得为了一个小件跑第二趟，一来一回反而更耽误时间。工具箱固定放在配电间旁边的架子上，用完随手归位。每周五交接的时候顺便检查一遍，缺的耗材记在箱子上的白板上，下周统一补。
我们的技术栈以 Python、TypeScript、Go 为主，配套的数据库、消息队列、对象存储等基础设施都在同一套编排里管理，新项目直接复用这套模板就行。文档、监控、告警等配套工具也已经接入统一平台，接入方式在 onboarding 手册里有一步步的说明。新同学入职第一周过一遍架构图，再照着模板起一个示例服务，基本就能上手。遇到不清楚的地方先在文档里搜，搜不到再问值班同学。
场地可以安排篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球等项目，具体排哪些看报名情况，器材按人数准备，球拍和球都多备一些备用。裁判、计时、记分等岗位也需要志愿者，报名时一并填写意向，我们会按人数统一分配。活动结束后大家一起把器材归位并清点，损坏的登记一下。整场活动的预算和物资清单会提前一周发到群里。

First the sorter splits the incoming stream into evenly sized runs that fit comfortably in memory, using a small read buffer per run. Second it merges those runs pairwise, repeatedly, until only one run remains and the whole input has been ordered. Third it writes the final sequence to disk and updates a small manifest with the row count and a checksum. Every stage is streaming and bounded, so at no point does the entire input need to fit in memory at once, which is what lets the job scale to files far larger than the box.

First install the toolchain and confirm the version matches the lockfile exactly, because a mismatch here causes confusing errors much later. If the smoke test passes you are ready to work; if it fails, copy the failing output into the onboarding channel and someone will help you the same day.
第一步先把输入按时间排序，保证后续处理看到的是一个单调序列，否则滑动窗口会前后颠倒。第二步对每个窗口计算均值并写入一张临时表，窗口大小和步长都做成参数，方便回放时复现。第三步把临时表按主键去重后合并回主表，冲突时保留时间较新的那条。三步都不依赖外部状态，任何一步都可以单独重跑，所以排查问题的时候可以直接从中间那一步开始。整个流程跑一遍大概两分钟。

First the load balancer stopped routing to one zone after a health check started flapping, which removed a third of the capacity in an instant. Second the remaining zones absorbed the full traffic and their connection pools saturated within seconds, so requests began to queue. Third the clients' own retries amplified the load further until the queue backed up and latencies crossed the timeout. The entire cascade took under two minutes, which is why the dashboards and the page fired almost simultaneously.
第一周先做需求澄清和原型验证，把最不确定的技术点跑通，宁可多花两天也别带着疑问进入开发。第二周进入正式开发，同时补齐测试用例，让测试和实现同步推进而不是最后补。第三周集中做联调和演练，重点验证回滚方案真的可用，而不是写在文档里。三周之后再根据实测速度定上线窗口，给可能的返工留出缓冲。每周末同步一次进度和风险，有偏差当场调整。

The deduplication layer hashes each incoming record on its natural key before the record ever reaches the writer, so duplicates are caught as early as possible. Identical hashes collapse into a single row and the first arrival wins, while later copies are counted and dropped. That is precisely why the row count stabilizes once we replay a batch, and why re-running a failed job is safe. In short the layer is doing exactly what it was designed to do, and the numbers in the report confirm it.

In short, the read-through cache keeps the hot working set in memory, misses fall through to the database and repopulate the entry on the way back, and every write invalidates the keys it touches. Under the measured workload the hit rate stays above ninety percent, and the p99 latency tracks the cache hit path rather than the database. The invalidation is conservative but correct, so we never serve a stale row after a write. Taken together, the design is meeting its target and no change is warranted right now.
总结一下：把采样率调到百分之十之后，日志量降了差不多一个数量级，磁盘写入不再打满，检索也快了很多。同时我们保留了错误级别的全量记录，关键故障的线索一条没丢，上次那种间歇性超时依然能完整还原。观测两天，没有发现排查能力有任何下降，反而因为噪声变少定位更快了。可以说这次调整达到了预期目标，暂时不需要再动采样策略了。
综上所述，把共享状态收敛到单个 actor 之后，所有写操作都在 actor 里串行化，读操作的是一份不可变快照，竞态条件从设计上就不存在了。压测下吞吐没有明显下降，因为瓶颈本来就在网络而不是在计算，而之前那些偶发的计数错误这几天再没出现过。代码也更好读，不再需要到处加锁。这个重构达到了预期效果，我建议保留并在下一个模块里推广同样的模式。
